text: Seabrook Town launches a swift counterattack from their left side near the halfway line. Aiden Quinlan intercepts the ball close to his own 26-metre mark and quickly passes long to Kian Adeyemi positioned just inside the final third on the right flank. Adeyemi advances the ball forward and finds Tariq Marlowe, who threads a through pass toward Callum Varga, running into space about 9 metres from Harbour City’s goal. Varga controls the ball and shoots with his foot into the net, equalizing the score at 2-2 in the 69th minute [#1442] [#1443] [#1444] [#1445] [#1446] [#1447] [#1448].
